notes.title: Speedrun Update is OUT NOW & Lil Gator Plush News
notes.notes:
Hey Gator Gang!

Patch, plush, plaudits! Let's take a look at what's going on in the world of Lil Gator.

We've got a brand new content update that'll have you speeding across the mountaintops from one end of the island to the other in the new speedrun mode!

For new members of the Gator Gang we recommend you take your time and savour the experience but if you're up for a challenge you can toggle the speed run timer on in the settings menu.

Already completed your adventure? Why not return and give the new speedrunning mode a go, discover shortcuts or alternative routes and let us know your fastest time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/018428518ae5feb76759da465b31090afd586fa4.jpg

That's not all! We've been processing the feedback from players and made some quality-of-life updates, such as:

 Foliage no longer obscures the camera as much.
 Character quest bugs have been tweaked/fixed.
 Text typos have been corrected.
And more! For the full patch notes please visit the forum.

If you run into any unexpected bugs on your adventure please report them in our 'Report a Problem' sub forum. 

[previewyoutube=kXHvtrIaWbU;full][/previewyoutube]
Have you seen the reviews Lil Gator Game has been getting? Take a look at what reviewers are saying about Lil Gator Game in our latest trailer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/ada194b5dec2bb201dbeb422e873d5c230b0c5c3.jpg

Our last update for you is of the cuddly variety. We've teamed up with Fangamer to bring you your very own Lil Gator plush complete with a hat and detachable sword and shield!

You can sign up now to be notified when they are ready to order.

See you out there gator gang! 


If you haven’t picked Lil Gator Game up yet, you can snag it at a whopping 30% off for a limited time. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

notes.title: Release Date inbound!
notes.notes:
Hi gator gang!

We know you’ve been waiting to hear when Lil Gator Game will be released and we’re excited to announce that the wait is nearly over!

Pack your stick, pot lid and glider, it's time to embark on your wholesome adventure with Lil Gator and pals when Lil Gator Game launches on Steam and Nintendo Switch on December 14th 2022 for £16.75/ €19,50/ $19.99! 

For those eager to join Lil Gator on their adventure, there will be a whopping 30% pre-order discount from December 1st on Steam and Nintendo Switch in Europe, and from December 5th on Nintendo Switch in North America making Lil Gator Game only £11.72/ €13,65/ $13.99!

Let's find out what fun we can expect on the island...

[previewyoutube=fGnOgktPvSo;full][/previewyoutube]

Lil Gator Game is on deck!
Yes, that's right, Lil Gator Game is officially Steam deck verified for launch! Play on the go or snuggled up under a blanket with a cup of hot cocoa and explore the lovingly crafted island full to the brim with areas to discover, friends to make and joy to be had.

See you on December 14th gator gang!
